Name: Howa's Nyapu-Style Isla NPC
Author: Howaa
Description:
Nyapu-style Isla portraits, using Nyapu's Emily & Abigail sprites as reference - I haven't played with Isla yet but wanted to have consistent portraits for my game. I updated the mod to include portraits for Elysa & Soraya as well as diverse portraits for Isla & Elysa.

To install, you will need to drop the files into your Isla Mod folder to manually overwrite the portrait sprites.

Unzip the mod, Find your mods folder, navigate to [CP] Isla, at this point, drop my assets folder in and overwrite the portraits and diverse portraits the original asset folder to install the new art. 

Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/92602143]PaperNautilus[/url] for Isla and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for their incredibly inspirational art~ 

& Thanks reader for being interested in my very first mod!

Downloads.Description: Update includes Portraits for Isla (clean up & tweaks), Soraya, & Elysa (brand new designs)
